claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Canon EOS 800D is visible on the body (photo 0 and photo 2). The lens appears to be the common 18-55mm kit lens but the exact “18-55mm” text is only partially readable (photo 0).
No UK-specific markings/serial/box documents are visible in the provided photos.

risks.risk: Shutter count/usage level unknown; “neat” can still mean high wear.
risks.proof: Ask for a screenshot/photo of the shutter count (or a camera menu screen showing shutter count) and the serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used camera with unknown shutter count (worst case within the comparable range).

risks.risk: Lens condition (fungus, haze, scratches) and autofocus performance not verifiable from these angles.
risks.proof: One clear close-up of the lens front element and rear element (straight-on), plus a short video showing autofocus on a nearby and far object.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens may need cleaning/has unknown optical condition (worst case).

risks.risk: Camera functions not tested remotely (buttons, viewfinder, sensor dust, SD card slot, HDMI/USB).
risks.proof: Video clip: power on → menu navigation → take a photo → playback on screen; also show SD card recognition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed working (worst case).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card) not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (battery + charger + any cables/strap + lens caps).

proof_requests: Screenshot/photo of shutter count and serial number.
Video: power on, menu, take photo, playback; show SD card recognition.
Close-up straight-on shots of lens front and rear elements (to check fungus/haze/scratches).
Photo of all included items (battery, charger, caps, strap, memory card if any).
response.reason: The photos clearly show a Canon EOS 800D body (and the kit-style 18-55mm lens appears consistent). Since the exact working condition and accessories aren’t proven, price it at the worst case within the matching comparables.
